authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-6-alpha targeting tenant-6-bravo/order-6.
Policy: administrators may PATCH across tenants; nonadministrators may PATCH only their own tenant. This record is the complete policy.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-6-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-6-bravo/order-6. The gateway records status 200, state_changed=true, and is_admin=false [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: An unauthorized cross-tenant write was achieved with verified state change. These records do not establish data exfiltration.
